_comment: TAP-6 method-audit grep baseline. Every entry is a KNOWN, register-tracked hit — i.e. a location the 2026-07-10 audit already found and filed as an OPEN register row (MARSYS_DEFECT_GAP_REGISTER_v2_0.md §11.1). tap6_method_grep.ts treats any grep hit matching (pattern, file, line_hash) here as QUARANTINED (expected, tracked, not a new failure). Any grep hit whose exact matched line is NOT in this baseline — whether a brand-new file or a second, unrelated occurrence in an already-baselined file — is a NEW violation and fails CI (Ring-2 fix, post-bacade1c: file-level keying was too coarse to catch a second unrelated occurrence in an already-baselined file). When a Phase-1 lane fixes an M-row, delete its baseline entries here so the grep starts enforcing the fix (ratchet). Regenerated 2026-07-10 by walking the live tree and hashing every matched line.
